name: metadata-equals-blank-never-matches
note: A blank value counts as absent, so equals:"" can never match. 'note' is set to the empty string — the exact value the blank-equals-never-matches rule (route local) compares against — yet that rule does not fire, and the request falls to default (cloud). consent:'granted' is set so it also misses the consent-exists-false rule.

name: metadata-gte-below-threshold-no-match
note: tool_error_streak '1' is below gte:2, so it misses and falls through to default (cloud).

name: metadata-gte-absent-key-no-match
note: No tool_error_streak key at all: a missing value never satisfies gte, the same absent-counts-as-no-match posture as equals/any.

name: metadata-gte-non-numeric-value-no-match
note: tool_error_streak 'many' is not numeric, so gte never matches it -- falls through to default rather than throwing.

name: metadata-gte-comma-list-value-no-match
note: gte/lte do not comma-decode like equals/any: '3,5' fails the full-value-must-be-numeric check (the comma is not part of a number), so it counts as non-numeric and never satisfies gte -- even though 3 alone would.

name: metadata-lte-above-threshold-no-match
note: budget_remaining '6' is above lte:5, so it misses and falls through to default (cloud).

name: metadata-gte-lte-trace
note: route_trace:true still records the leaf under condition 'metadata', the same name equals/any/exists use -- gte/lte are a comparator on the same leaf, not a new traced condition.
